fields.name: logo
fields.label: Header logo
fields.description: Optional. Shown at the left of the header. A transparent PNG or SVG works best.

fields.name: favicon
fields.label: Favicon
fields.description: The small icon in the browser tab. A square PNG or SVG, at least 64 × 64, works best.

fields.name: logoHeight
fields.label: Logo height (px)
fields.description: How tall the logo appears in the header, from 20 to 120. Default 44.

fields.name: headerText
fields.label: Header text
fields.description: Shown next to the logo. Leave empty to use the artist name.

fields.name: hideHeaderText
fields.label: Show logo only
fields.description: Hide the header text when a logo is set.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Home headline
fields.description: The large line on the home page.

fields.name: galleryLabel
fields.label: Gallery label
fields.description: The first menu tab and the heading above the gallery. Default "Work".

fields.name: heroButtonText
fields.label: Home button text
fields.description: The main button under the home intro, which jumps to the gallery. Default "View the work".

fields.name: hideHeroButton
fields.label: Hide home button
fields.description: Hide the main button under the home intro.

fields.name: socials
fields.label: Social links
fields.description: Shown as white icons in the footer, in this order.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image description (alt text)
fields.description: Briefly describe what the painting shows, for screen readers.

fields.name: medium
fields.label: Medium
fields.description: e.g. Oil on linen

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Feature on home page
fields.description: The first featured painting appears in the home page hero.

fields.name: buyUrl
fields.label: Checkout link (optional)
fields.description: A Stripe Payment Link or similar. Leave empty to use email inquiry only.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image description (alt text)
fields.description: Briefly describe what the print shows, for screen readers.

fields.name: painting
fields.label: Original painting (optional)
fields.description: Links the print and the painting to each other.

fields.name: printType
fields.label: Print type
fields.description: e.g. Giclée on cotton rag paper

fields.name: edition
fields.label: Edition
fields.description: e.g. Open edition, or Limited edition of 50

fields.name: sizes
fields.label: Sizes and prices
fields.description: Shown in this order. The lowest price appears on the Prints page.

fields.name: size
fields.label: Size
fields.description: e.g. 8 × 10 in

fields.name: shopUrl
fields.label: Shopify product link
fields.description: The product's page on your Shopify store. The Buy button goes here.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Hidden prints don't appear on the site, but stay here to edit or show again later.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Sort order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first on the Prints page. Leave empty to sort by title.
